lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat vas rahiaa jagajeevan daataa ||
lines.translation: He dwells in each and every heart, the Great Giver, the Life of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ik thai gupat paragat hai aape guramukh bhram bhau jaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: At the same time, He is both hidden and revealed. For the Gurmukh, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har jeeu eko jaataa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh knows the One, the Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar naam sabad pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: Deep within the nucleus of his inner being, is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis too dehi soee jan paae naanak naam vadaaee he ||16||4||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it. O Nanak, the Naam is glorious greatness. ||16||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
lines.translation: I praise the true, profound and unfathomable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag hai tis hee kai cheerai ||
lines.translation: All the world is in His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ghat bhogavai sadaa din raatee aape sookh nivaasee he ||1||
lines.translation: He enjoys all hearts forever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee ||
lines.translation: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape aai vasiaa ghat a(n)tar tootee jam kee phaasee he ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself has come to dwell deep within the nucleus of my heart; the noose of death has been snapped. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis sevee tai kis saalaahee ||
lines.translation: Whom should I serve, and whom should I praise?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevee sabad saalaahee ||
lines.translation: I serve the True Guru, and praise the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa mat ootam a(n)tar kamal pragaasee he ||3||
lines.translation: Through the True Shabad, the intellect is exalted and ennobled forever, and the lotus deep within blossoms forth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehee kaachee kaagad mikadaaraa ||
lines.translation: The body is frail and perishable, like paper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਢਹਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: boo(n)d pavai binasai dhahat na laagai baaraa ||
lines.translation: When the drop of water falls upon it, it crumbles and dissolves instantaneously.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa guramukh boojhai jis a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||4||
lines.translation: But the body of the Gurmukh, who understands, is like gold; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells deep within. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa chaukaa surat kee kaaraa ||
lines.translation: Pure is that kitchen, which is enclosed by spiritual awareness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam bhojan sach aadhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my food, and Truth is my support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa tripat pavitr hai paavan jit ghat har naam nivaasee he ||5||
lines.translation: Forever satisfied, sanctified and pure is that person, within whose heart the Lord's Name abides. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tin balihaaree jo saachai laage ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are attached to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi anadin jaage ||
lines.translation: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and remain awake and aware night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa sookh sadaa tin a(n)tar rasanaa har ras raasee he ||6||
lines.translation: True peace fills them forever, and their tongues savor the sublime essence of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam chetaa avar na poojaa ||
lines.translation: I remember the Lord's Name, and no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko sevee avar na doojaa ||
lines.translation: I serve the One Lord, and no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: poorai gur sabh sach dikhaaiaa sachai naam nivaasee he ||7||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed the whole Truth to me; I dwell in the True Name. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhram jonee phir phir aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Wandering, wandering in reincarnation, again and again, he comes into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap bhoolaa jaa khasam bhulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is deluded and confused, when the Lord and Master confuses him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu milai taa guramukh boojhai cheenai sabad abinaasee he ||8||
lines.translation: He meets with the Dear Lord, when, as Gurmukh, he understands; he remembers the Shabad, the Word of the immortal, eternal Lord God. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh bhare ham aparaadhee ||
lines.translation: I am a sinner, overflowing with sexual desire and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa muhu lai bolah naa ham gun na sevaa saadhee ||
lines.translation: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: dubade paathar mel laihu tum aape saach naam abinaasee he ||9||
lines.translation: I am a sinking stone; please, Lord, unite me with Yourself. Your Name is eternal and imperishable. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa koee kare na karanai jogaa ||
lines.translation: No one does anything; no one is able to do anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karahi karaavahi s hoigaa ||
lines.translation: That alone happens, which the Lord Himself does, and causes to be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas laihi sukh paae sad hee naam nivaasee he ||10||
lines.translation: Those whom He Himself forgives, find peace; they dwell forever in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan dharatee sabad beej apaaraa ||
lines.translation: This body is the earth, and the infinite Shabad is the seed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saache setee vanaj vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: Deal and trade with the True Name alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhan ja(n)miaa tot na aavai a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||11||
lines.translation: The True wealth increases; it is never exhausted, when the Naam dwells deep within. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu avaganiaare no gun keejai ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, please bless me, the worthless sinner, with virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas laihi naam deejai ||
lines.translation: Forgive me, and bless me with Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so pat paae ikat naam nivaasee he ||12||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, is honored; he dwells in the Name of the One Lord alone. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar har dhan samajh na hoee ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord is deep within one's inner being, but he does not realize it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee boojhai koee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so dhan paae sad hee naam nivaasee he ||13||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is blessed with this wealth; he lives forever in the Naam. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਲ ਵਾਉ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anal vaau bharam bhulaaee ||
lines.translation: Fire and wind lead him into delusions of doubt.
